SNARE.definition: Something (often something deceptively attractive) that catches you unawares.
SNARE.example: The exam was full of trap questions.

NEAR.gloss: near in time or place or relationship
NEAR.definition: Near in time or place or relationship.
NEAR.example: As the wedding day drew near.

EARN.gloss: earn on some commercial or business transaction
EARN.definition: Earn on some commercial or business transaction; earn as salary or wages.
EARN.example: How much do you make a month in your new job?

SANE.definition: Mentally healthy; free from mental disorder.

ARSE.gloss: the fleshy part of the human body that you sit on
ARSE.definition: The fleshy part of the human body that you sit on.
ARSE.example: He deserves a good kick in the butt.

ARE.gloss: a unit of surface area equal to 100 square meters
ARE.definition: A unit of surface area equal to 100 square meters.

SEA.gloss: a division of an ocean or a large body of salt water partially enclosed by land
SEA.definition: A division of an ocean or a large body of salt water partially enclosed by land.

ERA.gloss: a period marked by distinctive character or reckoned from a fixed point or event
ERA.definition: A period marked by distinctive character or reckoned from a fixed point or event.

EAR.gloss: the sense organ for hearing and equilibrium
EAR.definition: The sense organ for hearing and equilibrium.

SEN.gloss: a fractional monetary unit of Japan and Indonesia and Cambodia
SEN.definition: A fractional monetary unit of Japan and Indonesia and Cambodia; equal to one hundredth of a yen or rupiah or riel.
